title: Adapter manifest
description: How the conformance runner starts one connector's adapter, in a file named adapter.yaml in the directory that holds the adapter, beside the connector's expected-failures.yaml. The runner finds every such file the repository tracks and picks the one whose connector a run names. It belongs to no adapter protocol version: the adapter's hello names the version it speaks.

connector.description: The connector's name, which a run names and the adapter's hello must give.

command.description: The program the runner starts, without a shell, and its arguments. A program named with a slash is a path relative to the manifest's directory; any other is looked up first in the scripts directory of the runner's own environment, which `uv run` puts first on PATH, then on PATH. On Windows a program's .exe may be left out.

directory.description: The adapter's working directory, relative to the manifest's directory, with forward slashes.
